description: This file is a Next.js configuration file that sets up URL rewrites and HTTP headers for a Next.js frontend application. It customizes routing to proxy API requests to a backend server and adds security headers.

methods.name: rewrites
methods.description: Defines proxy rewrite rules for various API routes and documentation endpoints, redirecting frontend requests to the backend server.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Specifies security and content headers for all routes to enhance security.
